what: a box's top front edge chamfered by two distances: 3 along the top (the first face, the one facing up) and 1 down the front
method: box 40x30x20, the edge y=0, z=20: the triangle (0,20), (3,20), (0,19) in (y,z), area 1.5, along 40: V = 24000 - 60 = 23940. Its centroid (1, 59/3) fixes which leg went where: centre of mass (20, (360000 - 60)/23940, (240000 - 60 * 59/3)/23940), graded to 0.0005 mm (flipped, it moves 0.0017 mm in y and z). Faces 7.
